title: Designing Transformers for Continuous Diffusion Language Models

summary.en: A systematic study of normalization, noise conditioning, gradient routing, and self-conditioning. LangDiT improves continuous language generation within LangFlow and transfers compatible components to a Plaid-style formulation.
summary.zh: 系统研究归一化、噪声条件、梯度路由与自条件机制。LangDiT 在 LangFlow 中改善连续语言生成，并将兼容的组件迁移到 Plaid 类模型。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of LangDiT: continuous states, transformer computation and joint token predictions.

summary.zh: 展开论文结果与评测条件

caption.zh: OpenWebText · 1,024 token 无条件生成 · GenPPL 越低越好

note.en: Extended-training checkpoints: LangFlow 660k; Plaid-style 520k updates. Plaid-style sampling uses one additional final denoiser call. These scores use different training budgets and do not establish an isolated architecture gain or wall-clock speedup. See the paper for entropy, controls, and full settings.
note.zh: 延长训练的检查点：LangFlow 660k、Plaid 类模型 520k 更新。Plaid 类采样还包含一次最终去噪调用。不同训练预算下的分数不能单独证明架构收益或实际运行加速；熵、对照实验和完整配置见论文。
